statement: At the start of Buffer.Read, lastRead is assigned opInvalid.
At the start of Buffer.Read, lastRead is assigned opRead.
The cited assignment guarantees that the buffer can never contain unread bytes.
After a ReadByte succeeds, Read(nil) occurs and then UnreadByte succeeds.
Buffer.ReadByte returns io.EOF when no byte is available.
fragment: If no byte is available, it returns error [io.EOF].
